summary: Practise ESG data mapping, validation, finance integration, and assurance preparation. Explore the course and build reporting-ready skills.
lede: ESG data management and reporting assurance training helps sustainability, finance, and audit professionals turn sustainability information into controlled, traceable reporting data. You practise mapping data ownership and lineage, designing validation controls, applying double materiality, documenting emissions calculations and assurance evidence, and connecting sustainability metrics with financial reporting workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own, produce, review, or govern sustainability data and disclosures. It is particularly relevant when your work requires coordination between sustainability teams, finance, internal audit, and assurance providers.
modules: IFRS S1 and S2 Data Requirements
prerequisites: Working familiarity with sustainability reporting, finance reporting, audit, or compliance processes is recommended. No programming is required. Bring access to a spreadsheet application for the data-mapping and validation exercises; no specialized ESG software is assumed.
